metadata.title: On the anisotropic mean curvature flow in the Gaussian space
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we study the anisotropic mean curvature flow in the Gaussian space endowed with a Finsler metric obtained from a Minkowski metric by a conformal deformation. We first derive the conformal transformation formulas for the fundamental tensor, the Cartan tensor, and the Chern connection of the conformally related Finsler metrics. Based on these formulas, we express the anisotropic mean curvature in the Gaussian space in terms of the corresponding anisotropic mean curvature with respect to the original Minkowski metric, and derive the associated evolution equation. Finally, we establish the short-time existence and uniqueness of smooth solutions by reformulating the geometric evolution equation as a strictly parabolic quasilinear partial differential equation.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 演化方程与短时适定性
analysis.workSummary: 研究由Minkowski度量作共形变形得到的Finsler高斯空间中的各向异性平均曲率流。先推导基本张量、Cartan张量及Chern联络的共形变化公式，再把高斯空间各向异性平均曲率与原Minkowski度量下的平均曲率联系起来，导出流方程。最后将几何演化写成严格抛物拟线性方程，建立光滑解的短时存在唯一性。
techniques: Finsler张量和Chern联络的共形变换
各向异性平均曲率的转换
几何流的严格抛物方程化
analysis.breakthrough: 为这一共形Finsler高斯模型建立具体流方程及短时适定性。
analysis.limitations: 摘要只给短时存在唯一性，未声称长期存在、收敛或奇点分类；初始超曲面和各向异性正则条件需正文核对。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
